title: Fort Bragg High School
subtitle: Washington, D.C. April 11-15, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Fort Bragg High School. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Washington, D.C. & National Museum of American History

  • Travel to Washington, D.C.!
  • Visit the National Museum of American History
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the National 9/11 Pentagon Memorial 
  • Visit the Thomas Jefferson, Franklin Delano Roosevelt, and MLK Memorials around the Tidal Basin
  • Check-in to Hotel Accommodations with Overnight Security (four nights)
 

Day 2: Supreme Court Building & United States Capitol Building

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the National Gallery of Art
  • Lunch
  • Visit the Supreme Court Building Exhibit
  • Guided Tour of the United States Capitol Building
  • Meet and Greet with your Representative- Pending Availability
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Visit the Lincoln Memorial, Vietnam, and Korean War Memorials, World War II Memorial, and Washington Monument 
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 3: US Marine Corps War Memorial: Iwo Jima & The People’s House

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Tour Director Led Walking Tour of Arlington National Cemetery 
  • Visit the US Marine Corps War Memorial: Iwo Jima
  • Lunch Allocation
  • Visit The People’s House
  • White House Photo Opportunity Stop from Lafayette Park/Pennsylvania Avenue
  • Visit the Ford’s Theater, Petersen House, and Aftermath Exhibits
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Watch a Performance at Ford’s Theater
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: Smithsonian National Zoological Park & National Museum of American Indian

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Smithsonian National Zoological Park 
  • Guided Tour of Georgetown University with Admissions Session
  • Lunch
  • Georgetown Neighborhood Exploration
  • Visit the National Museum of the American Indian 
  • Exploration of National Harbor
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations
 

Day 5: Mount Vernon & Steven F. Udar-Hazy Center

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the National Museum of African American History and Culture
  • Lunch Allocation 
  • Visit George Washington’s Mount Vernon Estate 
  • Visit the Steven F. Udar-Hazy Center
  • Dinner Allocation
  • Departure for Home
introHeading: Fort Bragg High School, get ready for an unforgettable Washington, D.C. adventure in 2027! 🏛️
introText: From iconic memorials to world-class museums, this Washington, D.C. experience brings history, culture, and civic pride to life at every turn. Students will stand at the Lincoln Memorial, reflect at the World War II Memorial, and explore the halls of the United States Capitol Building. They'll also discover powerful stories at the National Museum of African American History and Culture, walk the grounds of Arlington National Cemetery, and get an up-close look at American democracy at the Supreme Court Building. It's the perfect blend of education, inspiration, and excitement — an experience your students will never forget!
